_about: Simple words for x3_people (Act IV people and side quests in Moonfall): templates for text built with numbers or names. Lines written with S() in the code carry their own simple words.

75waan.o: Look up at the tallest palm ({1} is at the top)

1w0tsiy.o: {1} the lamp sits at the very top of the tallest palm. The trunk is far too smooth to climb with bare claws.
1w0tsiy.s: The lamp is at the top of the palm. Too smooth to climb.

1dx296a.o: You dig in your Climbing Claws and go up the palm, scale by scale. A coconut glares at you. At the top, {1} the lamp is cold.
1dx296a.s: You climb the palm with your claws. A coconut glares at you.

1kd94ub.o: {1} hangs on a very tall pole. Your flame won't reach. A long, hot flame might. Or fly up to it.
1kd94ub.s: It's too high. Try a long hot flame. Or fly up.

1c2r8td.o: {1} stands by the Moon Well. Breathe on her to light her.
1c2r8td.s: Breathe on the lamp to light it.

1gw2ype.o: {1} the lamp is cold. Breathe on her to light her.
1gw2ype.s: The lamp is cold. Breathe on it.

1bjkel8.o: Drive in the ferry posts with a Ground Pound and grapple the line across ({1}/3)
1bjkel8.s: Pound the ferry posts down. Throw the line with your tail. ({1}/3)

1oldpaz.o: Clear the two Crab Pirate forts ({1}/2)

1ikcc7m.o: Blow up the three rocks blocking the Bubble Caves under Palmcrest ({1}/3)
1ikcc7m.s: Blow up the three rocks under Palmcrest ({1}/3)

119e1px.o: A moth flutters over to it. {1} of 6
119e1px.s: A moth flies to it. {1} of 6

1ge9v1u.o: Widen the Burrow Gap so Vesper can crawl through (burrow under it three times) ({1}/3)
1ge9v1u.s: Burrow under the Burrow Gap three times ({1}/3)

ntnb2o.o: Plant Vesper’s three moth-smoke bombs at the Moth Knight posts by the Moonpath, unseen ({1}/3)
ntnb2o.s: Plant 3 smoke bombs by the Moth Knights. Don’t get seen! ({1}/3)
